summary: LuxExperience B.V., through its subsidiary, oversees an international online retail platform that caters to customers in Germany, the United States, and throughout Europe and other global markets. The company's diverse selection features apparel for women, men, and children, as well as premium fine jewelry, timepieces, and various lifestyle goods. These items are presented under prominent brand identities including Mytheresa, NET-A-PORTER, MR PORTER, YOOX, and the OUTNET. Founded in 1987 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the firm was formerly recognized as MYT Netherlands Parent B.V. before rebranding to LuxExperience B.V. in May 2025.
